title: When the Alibi Burns
author: Mirabel Fairweather
blurb: Paloma Montrose, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
